archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) fused with Archetype 2 (Performance Pro)
emotional_tone: High-energy, authoritative, thrilling, and instantly engaging.
design_principles: Dark-First Workflow: True deep blacks (#09090B) to emulate OLED focus, pushing vibrant neon accents forward.
Tactical Gamification: Elements like the Rate Wall and Credit Economy use 'digital playground' mechanics (streaks, badges, glowing progress bars).
Signature Hero: The 'TipJar' is the literal centerpiece—a beautifully crafted CSS/Canvas glassmorphic jar with floating elements.
Kinetic Urgency: The primary 1-tap Bell notification uses vivid Electric Pink to command attention without feeling like a generic 'warning'.
Optical Hierarchy: Use size and opacity for text hierarchy. Tabular numerals for all sports odds and stats.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-white

typography.notes: Both Outfit and Manrope are chosen specifically for their robust support of English, German (äöü), and Greek character sets while maintaining an athletic, modern tech aesthetic.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first. Generous padding in macro-layouts (p-12 to p-24 for sections), tight tactical spacing in micro-components (p-4 for betting cards).
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. The Rate Wall feed items should span col-span-12 md:col-span-8, while the gamification 'streaks/leaderboard' widgets span col-span-4.
spacing_and_layout.surfaces: Glassmorphic overlay for the Hero Jar and Sticky Header (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`). Cards are pure flat `#18181B` with 1px solid `#27272A` borders to avoid 'muddy' shadows.

header_nav.style: Sticky at top (`z-50`), Crystal Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60`), 1px bottom border (`border-white/10`).
header_nav.bell_notification: Absolute prominence. Color `#FF1E56`. Uses `framer-motion` to jiggle/pulse on interval. Requires `data-testid='notification-bell'`.
header_nav.language_switcher: Dropdown menu for EN, DE, GR. Compact.

hero_animated_jar.concept: The platform signature. A large, stylized 'Jar' in the center.
hero_animated_jar.implementation: Container shaped like a jar using thick glowing borders and inner shadow (`box-shadow: inset 0 0 50px rgba(225,255,0,0.1)`). Inside, use `framer-motion` to animate multiple circular `div` 'balls' or 'coins' floating up and down with varied sine-wave timings and spring physics.
hero_animated_jar.text: Overlaid or adjacent high-energy storytelling text explaining the TipJar platform.

submit_tip_modal.style: Shadcn Dialog. Dark surface `#18181B`. High-end feel.
submit_tip_modal.layout: Two paths inside: 'Open Tutorial' (carousel/tabs showing Argentina vs Cape Verde examples) or 'Direct Upload' (drag-and-drop zone with dashed border).
submit_tip_modal.ai_feedback: Once uploaded, a simulated 'scanning' laser effect (`framer-motion`), followed by auto-populating form inputs with team names, odds, etc.

rate_wall_feed.concept: The core social engagement loop. A feed of pending tips.
rate_wall_feed.card_style: Tactical Minimalism. Flat dark cards, crisp edges (max `rounded-lg`).
rate_wall_feed.rating_system: The 'Apex Scale' (1 to 10 stars). Use segmented bars or high-tech stars. As user clicks higher ratings, the color shifts from white to `#E1FF00`.
rate_wall_feed.gamification: Include a 'Vibe Check' streak counter at the top of the wall. Upon rating, trigger `canvas-confetti` or a small micro-interaction burst.

credits_economy.display: Prominent user wallet balance shown in navbar (`text-[#E1FF00] font-mono`).
credits_economy.actions: Buy/Gift/Redeem buttons using solid primary color for high-conversion.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (`-translate-y-1`) with a border color transition to `#E1FF00`.
motion_and_interaction.page_load: Staggered fade-up for feed items using `framer-motion` (`initial={{opacity: 0, y: 20}}`).

hero_background.description: Aerial view of a night football match. Use with heavy dark overlay (`bg-black/80`) to create depth behind the Animated Jar.

credits_gamification_asset.description: Gold coins. Can be used as a thumbnail or masked asset in the 'Redeem/Buy Credits' modal.

testing.requirements: ALL interactive elements (Bell, Rate Stars, Submit Tip, Buy Credits, Language Switcher) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid='submit-tip-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Configure `tailwind.config.js` with the provided color palette (Void Black, Surface, Volt Yellow, Electric Pink).
Add 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' via Google Fonts in `index.html`, ensuring Greek character sets are loaded (`&subset=greek`).

Build the Animated TipJar using raw React + Framer Motion. Do not overcomplicate with 3D libraries unless necessary; a sleek CSS glassmorphic container with SVG/div balls animated via `framer-motion` variants provides the best 'cute but smooth' effect.
Ensure the Bell Notification is immediately visible without user authentication state logic blocking it.
For the 10-star rating system, map an array of 10 elements, visually styling them to represent the 'Apex Scale'.

Build out Shadcn components (Dialog, Button, Input) but aggressively override their default styles to match the dark 'Tactical' athletic look (remove default Vercel-like soft shadows, use pure borders).
